title: The Tortoise and the Birds
author: Conte igbo (Nigeria)
desc: La tortue emprunte des plumes pour aller au festin du ciel… mais elle est trop gourmande.

p: Long ago, there was a great famine on the earth. There was no food. All the animals were hungry.
One day, the birds heard some wonderful news. The people of the sky were having a big feast. There would be meat, fish, fruit and palm wine.
Tortoise heard the news too. He was very hungry. But Tortoise had no wings.
"Dear friends," he said to the birds with his sweetest voice. "Please take me with you. I will be so good. And I can speak for you. I know how to talk to important people."
The birds did not trust Tortoise. He was famous for his tricks. But he talked and talked, and finally they said yes.
Each bird gave Tortoise one feather. Soon he had a beautiful coat of many colours. And together, they flew up to the sky.
On the way, Tortoise said: "In the sky, it is the custom to take a new name. My new name is *All of You*."
The birds thought it was strange, but they agreed.
When they arrived, the people of the sky were very happy to see them. They brought big dishes of food.
"Who is this food for?" asked Tortoise.
"This food is for all of you," said the people of the sky.
"Did you hear?" said Tortoise to the birds. "It is for *All of You*. That's my name! You can eat after me."
And he ate. And ate. And ate. The birds only got the bones.
The birds were very angry. One by one, each bird took back its feather. Soon, Tortoise had no wings again. He was alone in the sky.
"How can I go home?" he cried.
He asked Parrot to take a message to his wife: "Tell her to put all the soft things from the house on the ground. Mats, cushions, blankets. I am going to jump."
But Parrot was angry too. He told the wife: "Tortoise says: bring all the hard things out. Pots, stones, hoes."
Tortoise jumped. He fell, and fell, and fell… and crash! He landed on the hard things. His shell broke into many pieces.
His wife found a doctor, who glued the pieces back together. And this is why, even today, the shell of the tortoise is not smooth. It is made of many little pieces.
